description: The reference input. The report covers every source file — the template among them — the target declares both thresholds and the coverage meets them; the template stands at its own floor, and the one metric that does not reach it has an exception with a reason. The tree holds the three sources and one file of every category NOT_A_SOURCE excuses — a stylesheet, a spec, a types file, the version stamp, the mutation harness, the ng-add schematic — so that point 2 staying silent on each of them is measured, and a category deleted reddens the reference rather than nothing. Cases are built on a copy of this file, so each of them holds nothing but its own defect.

functions.reason: one listener the browser raises and jsdom would only imitate — guarded by an e2e instead. The reference carries this on purpose: a case directory can prove the floor FIRES, and that the gate stays silent where an exception says why has nowhere else to be shown.
